mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level indicates tighter monetary policy, which increases discount rates for equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5%), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising FEDFUNDS), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in more than 55% of monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production index (INDPRO) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500.0 thousand units, it signals a housing market slowdown that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1500.0), or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (as indicated by strong GDP growth), the S&P 500 typically experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are negative in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
